title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Illegal Manufacture, Trading, Transport, and Storage of Tetramine and Other Banned Highly Toxic Chemicals

articles.content_en:
Article 1 Where any person illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores prohibited highly toxic chemicals such as tetramine, thereby endangering public security, and falls under any of the following circumstances, he or she shall, in accordance with the provisions of Article 125 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, be convicted of the crime of illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing hazardous substances and shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years:
(1) illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing 50 grams or more of raw powder, stock solution, or preparation, or 2 kilograms or more of bait; or
(2) causing serious injury, death, or causing public or private property losses of 100,000 yuan or more during the illegal manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing process.

Article 2 Where any person illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores prohibited highly toxic chemicals such as tetramine, and falls under any of the following circumstances, such conduct shall fall under the "serious circumstances" as provided in Article 125 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, and the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or the death penalty:
(1) illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing 500 grams or more of raw powder, stock solution, or preparation, or 20 kilograms or more of bait;
(2) causing serious injury to or death of three or more persons, or causing public or private property losses of 200,000 yuan or more during the illegal manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing process; or
(3) illegally manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing 50 grams of raw powder, stock solution, or preparation, or 2 kilograms or more but less than 20 kilograms of bait, and having other serious circumstances.

Article 3 Where a unit illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores prohibited highly toxic chemicals such as tetramine, the conviction and sentencing standards as provided in Articles 1 and 2 of this Interpretation shall apply.

Article 4 Where any State organ staff member who bears the duty of investigating and punishing the illegal manufacturing, buying, selling, transporting, or storing of prohibited highly toxic chemicals such as tetramine abuses his or her power or neglects his or her duty, thereby causing major losses to public property, the State, or the interests of the people, he or she shall, in accordance with the provisions of Article 397 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, be investigated for criminal liability for the crime of abuse of power or the crime of dereliction of duty.

Article 5 Before this Interpretation comes into force, where any person illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores bait of prohibited highly toxic chemicals such as tetramine for personal use due to genuine production or living needs, and no serious social harm has been caused, the conduct may, in accordance with the provisions of Article 13 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, not be treated as a crime.
After this Interpretation comes into force, where any person illegally manufactures, buys, sells, transports, or stores bait of prohibited highly toxic chemicals such as tetramine for personal use due to genuine production or living needs, which constitutes a crime, but no serious social harm has been caused, and the person after being educated shows genuine repentance, the punishment may be given a lighter or mitigated sentence, or the person may be exempted from punishment according to law.

Article 6 For the purpose of this Interpretation, "prohibited highly toxic chemicals such as tetramine" refers to tetramine, fluoroacetamide, sodium fluoroacetate, silatrane, and gliftor (fluridone) that are explicitly prohibited by the State (see the Appendix).
August 27, 2003
